name: voice_phone
title: Voice — phone (Twilio)
description: A phone number the agent answers and calls from. Twilio carries the line to OpenAI Realtime over SIP; the agent answers as itself and every sentence lands in the conversation. OpenAI and Twilio must be able to reach this instance.

number.label: Twilio number
number.hint: The Twilio voice number, E.164. Calls to it reach the agent; the agent's calls come from it.

project.label: OpenAI project ID
project.hint: The project whose key calls run on. Its SIP connector webhook points at this instance: /api/v1/data_source/webhook/voice_phone.
